title: Kusanagi Nene — Little Princess〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, ahem!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Today was originally intended to be a celebration for the end of the ArcLand workshop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But with our decision to participate in the contest, it is now a kickoff party, effective immediately!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's put together the greatest show we can, and win glory upon the stage at the Center Theatre!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's do it, everyone!
Won-won hip-hip-hooray!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hooray!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, this is an amazing opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even just participating in the workshop taught us so much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And to think, now we might even have a chance to perform for real!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah! I'm all fired up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And the contest's theme is ArcLand's motto, “anyone can be a princess”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This contest may not be for the public eye, but it's a true honor to work with this theme at ArcLand itself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's exciting, but it makes me nervous too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of ArcLand's princess shows are amazing. We'll have to work really hard not to look terrible by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, all their princesses are so pretty and sparkly and wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I always wanted to be an ArcLand princess...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Princesses really do have that kind of magnetism.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Especially when you're little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember begging my mom to get me a princess ballgown when I was young.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Of course, a ballgown was too much... But she did buy me a frilly dress to make up for it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Swishing the skirt around really made me feel like a princess... I still remember how happy it made me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When Saki was little, she used to absolutely adore any storybooks I read her with princesses in them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe everyone wants to be a princess at least a little bit, deep down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps that's why ArcLand has become famous the world over for its motto.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, hey! Do you have any pictures of you from back then, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh... Pictures?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pictures of Princess Nene! I just know you were super cute!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I don't know about that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. You're looking rather evasive, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, shut up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe we may have one or two pictures of Nene like that at home.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What the heck?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I produced a show involving a princess when I was young, and I had Nene play the role of the princess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She was so happy to be a princess, in fact, that she wore the toy tiara for the rest of the day and seemed very pleased with herself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene, you're so cute!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe you remember that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My mother took pictures of the show for us, so the photos should still be somewhere at home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hooray! You'll have to show us next time, Rui! And tell us all kinds of cute stories about little Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, there's—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, alright.
I'm afraid that's all I can offer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, to think there was such an anecdote about Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe we should build our show for the contest around a princess, played by our expert Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna see Nene play a princess!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This contest is really important, okay? We can't decide on it just like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly...
